items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Carlos Gastel, who was a representative for the Woody Herman band, used to come in the club every night and listen to the band. Little did we realize he was scouting Bob Graf...

ctx.x: Did – do you remember Wardell Gray being in that group?

Absolutely. I was the best man at his wedding while he was in that group. He had been married to Geri Gray, the dancer who just recently passed away. That’s how Geri Gray got her name, from Wardell Gray. At this point he was married to Dorothy. He was getting married to Dorothy. They got married in [Las] Vegas, and I was the best man at their wedding. At one point, when Bob Graf was with us at the Brass Rail – Carlos Gastel, who was a representative for the Woody Herman band, used to come in the club every night…
What was your estimation of Wardell Gray as a player?
